audit.whatIsWrong: Every row of the level chart gave the stage to Shen or called it Skill, while every why[], every spike and the early/mid/late blocks say Illaoi wins the stage.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Illaoi for all seven stages at 52.97%. On disk the sides read Skill, Shen, Shen, Skill, Skill, Shen, Shen while whys[0..6] read 'you dictate Level 1 trades', 'your Tentacle threat still out-pressures his farming', 'swings hard your way', 'his shield blocks autos but not your Tentacle slams', 'R Leap of Faith at 6 punishes every Q step-up', 'kills his soul before his Q can answer', 'your Tentacle DPS out-damages Shen in any straight duel'. The mid block literally says 'Levels 3-6 are firmly yours' under two Shen rows.
audit.corrected: All seven rows flipped to Illaoi in both layers as one atomic group, ratings raised to match.

audit.why: Spike timings (3-5, 6, first item, late) hold: Harsh Lesson online at 3, Leap of Faith at 120/95/70s, and Shen's Stand United at 200/180/160s is a map spike rather than a duelling one.
audit.corrected: Kept; the numbers were added to the level-3 spike instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says four separate times that Shen has no dash — whys[2] 'a dashless Shen', spikes[0] 'no dash, only his Spirit's Refuge shield', early 'his lack of any dash', wants.you[0] 'Shen has no dash to escape the pull'.
audit.why: Riot on Shadow Dash (E): 'Shen dashes in a direction, taunting enemies in his path' — 600 range, 18/16/14/12/10s, 150 mana. It is both a dash and his hard CC, and the same page's own tldr, focus and cooldown block are built around tracking it. Telling a player Shen cannot dash out of Test of Spirit, when dashing out is exactly what he does, is the most dangerous line on the page: the whole Illaoi pattern depends on the spirit staying in range. The real advice is the reverse — make him spend the 18-second dash first.
audit.corrected: Every 'no dash' claim replaced with the real sequencing: bait Shadow Dash (18s at rank 1, 150 mana), then land Test of Spirit.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns and report[5] name Shadow Dash as matchup-defining but give no duration, and Spirit's Refuge is never given one.
audit.why: Shadow Dash 18/16/14/12/10s at 600 range for 150 mana; Spirit's Refuge 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s; Twilight Assault 8/7.25/6.5/5.75/5s; Stand United 200/180/160s — against Test of Spirit at 16s and Harsh Lesson at 4s. The 18-second taunt at rank 1 is by far the longest cooldown in the lane and is the window worth naming.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into the cooldown block, report[5], dosFull[0] and the level-3 spike.

audit.why: 52.97% Emerald+. Note the packet reports 1416 games while the brief header says 1612 — recorded, not acted on.

edits.before: Level 3 E on a dashless Shen is near-guaranteed and swings hard your way.
edits.after: Level 3: bait his Shadow Dash 18s, then E him with no escape left.

edits.before: Land E — Shen has no dash to escape the pull
edits.after: Land E after his Shadow Dash — no escape left

edits.before: Shen has no way to dodge E Test of Spirit — no dash, only his Spirit's Refuge shield — so W-gap in, land E, and every Tentacle slam beats on his soul while he can only block auto-attacks, not slams.
edits.after: Shadow Dash is his only escape and it is 18 seconds at rank 1 — make him spend it taunting you off a wave, then W-gap in, land Test of Spirit, and beat on his soul while Spirit's Refuge is still 16 seconds away.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 favour you: Shen is a low-early-damage tank who wants to farm, and your Tentacle threat plus his lack of any dash means you dictate the trades from the start.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 favour you: Shen is a low-damage tank who wants to farm, and Shadow Dash costs 150 mana, so your Tentacle threat dictates the trades from the start.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 are firmly yours. E Test of Spirit is near-unmissable on a dashless Shen, his Spirit's Refuge only blocks auto-attacks and not your Tentacle slams, and R Leap of Faith turns any step-up into a slam-field beating.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 are firmly yours. Shadow Dash is an 18-second taunt and his only escape, so trade after he spends it — Test of Spirit lands clean, and R Leap of Faith turns any Twilight Assault step-up into a slam-field beating.

edits.before: His engage CC. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His taunt and his only escape, 18s at rank 1 — fight once spent.

edits.before: Track Shen's Shadow Dash (Taunt): His engage CC. Dodge it. When it is down — Slam him in your field.
edits.after: Shadow Dash is an 18s taunt and his only escape — bait it, then W in and slam him in your field.

edits.before: - Shen Shadow Dash: matchup-defining — His engage CC. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Shen Shadow Dash (18s at rank 1, 150 mana): his taunt and his only escape — fight after it. - Spirit's Refuge 16s blocks attacks. - Test of Spirit 16s: never on chip. - Leap of Faith: kill windows only.

notes: UNVERIFIED and deliberately left as it stands: the page asserts in three places (spikes[0], whys[3], wants.you[1]) that Spirit's Refuge blocks auto-attacks but not Tentacle slams. Riot's text says only 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked' — whether a Tentacle swing counts as an attack for that block is not answerable from the kit files, so the claim was neither strengthened nor removed. It is worth one authoritative check, because the whole level-3 spike leans on it. Also noted: the packet reports 1416 games for this matchup while the brief header says 1612.
